eCQM execution corpus — four patient-based proportion measures with their test patients.

Upstream: https://github.com/cqframework/ecqm-content-r4-2021
  commit 8790bae5baa29954f52558c0519f0bdb0e46c0f2 (retrieved 2026-11-01); License: CC0-1.0
Copied verbatim:
  cql/        input/cql/<Library>.cql for the measures and every library they include (12)
  measure/    input/resources/measure/<Measure>.json (population criteria = define names)
  tests/      input/tests/<Measure>/ (or input/tests/measure/<Measure>/): one directory per test patient,
              resources by type; some carry an expected MeasureReport (measurereport-*.json)
  valueset/   the 57 value sets the libraries declare, from input/vocabulary/valueset (with expansions)
Measures: BreastCancerScreeningsFHIR (EXM125), CervicalCancerScreeningFHIR (EXM124),
ColorectalCancerScreeningsFHIR (EXM130), DiabetesHemoglobinA1cHbA1cPoorControl9FHIR (CMS122).
Expected results: the MeasureReport when the case has one; otherwise the repository's test-case naming
convention (numer- / numer-…-FAIL- / denom- / denomexcl- or exclusion- / neg-ip- or no-ip-), see
tests/measure-harness.rkt.
